answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A vertex of per-task receipts records who did what, and the canyon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the inlet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
